stemMd: Which equation describes a circle centred at the origin and passing through (3,4)?
explanationMd: The radius is the distance from the origin to (3,4), namely five. A circle centred at the origin has equation x² + y² = r², so the right side is 25. The point satisfies 9 + 16 = 25.

distractorRationale.d: Five is the radius, while the equation uses radius squared.
distractorRationale.e: This adds coordinates rather than their squares.
distractorRationale.b: This moves the centre to the point rather than keeping it at the origin.
distractorRationale.a: This is a line, not a circle.
